codes.name: ISO

codes.name: Random

Usually a base64 encoded string of random bits.

Note: Random IDs are typically used for instance identifiers, rather than an identifier of an Assigning Authority that issues instance identifiers

codes.name: UUID
codes.description: The DCE Universal Unique Identifier, in accordance with RFC 4122. Recommended format is 32 hexadecimal digits separated by hyphens, in the digit grouping 8-4-4-4-12

codes.name: x400
